filesystem._replace: C:/DEV/YOUR_PROJECT_FOLDER → đường dẫn root folder project thực tế, ví dụ: C:/DEV/MyApp

github._replace: ghp_REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN → tạo token tại github.com/settings/tokens, tick quyền: repo + issues + pull_requests

postgres._replace: Thay YOUR_PG_USER, YOUR_PG_PASSWORD, YOUR_PG_DATABASE. Dùng readonly user, không dùng sa/admin

sqlserver._replace: Thay YOUR_MSSQL_DATABASE, YOUR_MSSQL_USER, YOUR_MSSQL_PASSWORD. Azure SQL thì đổi MSSQL_ENCRYPT=true và MSSQL_HOST=your-server.database.windows.net

redis._replace: Nếu Redis có password: redis://:YOUR_REDIS_PASSWORD@localhost:6379. Azure Cache: rediss://YOUR_HOST:6380?password=YOUR_KEY

playwright._replace: Không cần config — Claude tự mở browser, click, fill form, chụp screenshot. Cần Playwright installed: npx playwright install

azure-devops._replace: YOUR_ORG_NAME → tên Azure DevOps organization. PAT: dev.azure.com → User Settings → Personal Access Tokens, tick: Work Items (Read/Write), Code (Read), Build (Read)

roslyn._replace: Thay path đến .sln file thực tế. Claude dùng Roslyn để tìm symbols, references, detect circular deps — chính xác hơn filesystem grep ~10x token savings
